nodes.label: HVPS Sports Apple Touch Icon
nodes.rationale: iOS home-screen / Apple Web App icon: a rounded square, wordless, high-contrast mark designed to stay readable at small sizes.

nodes.label: iOS Home Screen / Apple Web App Icon
nodes.norm_label: ios home screen / apple web app icon

nodes.label: Wordless Geometric Identity
nodes.rationale: No wordmark, photo, or gradient: a single centered glyph on a solid field so the icon remains recognizable as a PWA home-screen tile.

nodes.label: Lime on Forest Palette
nodes.rationale: High-contrast lime-chartreuse stroke on near-black forest green reads at small launcher sizes and matches the app theme.

nodes.label: Maskable Safe Layout
nodes.rationale: The mark is centered with generous padding so circular/squircle launcher masks do not clip the glyph.

nodes.label: HVPS Sports Brand Identity
nodes.rationale: Wordless circled-plus on a dark sports-green field is the standalone app mark for the HVPS Sports PWA.

nodes.label: PWA App Icon 512
nodes.rationale: 512x512 PNG used as the large Progressive Web App launcher icon: a rounded-square mark with a lime-green plus inside a lime-green circle on a near-black field, with no wordmark.

nodes.label: Two-Color High-Contrast Palette
nodes.rationale: Only a near-black / very dark green field and a lime-green mark are used, maximizing contrast so the glyph stays distinct at small home-screen sizes.

nodes.label: Flat Geometric Icon Style
nodes.rationale: No text, gradient, drop shadow, or pictorial sports imagery: a single circle-plus glyph remains readable under OS rounded-rect / maskable-icon crops.

nodes.label: PWA Launcher Identity
nodes.rationale: 512px is the standard large PWA / Android icon size for install, splash, and home-screen launcher surfaces.

nodes.label: HVPS Sports App Icon
nodes.rationale: Canonical 512×512 vector source for HVPS Sports PWA/app icons: a pitch-green rounded square with a lime ring and centered crosshair. Rasterized to icon-192.png, icon-512.png, and apple-touch-icon.png.

nodes.label: Pitch-Green Rounded Square
nodes.rationale: Full-bleed rounded rect (512×512, rx=96) filled #071910. Reads as a dark sports-pitch field and as an iOS-style squircle app-icon mask.

nodes.label: Lime Circle
nodes.rationale: Unfilled center circle (cx=256, cy=256, r=148) stroked #c6e86b at 28px. Forms the outer ring of the targeting mark.

nodes.label: Lime Crosshair
nodes.rationale: Centered plus-sign path (M256 140v232 M140 256h232), stroke #c6e86b, 28px, round caps. Arms sit inside the ring with a small gap, reading as a reticle or pitch marking.

nodes.label: Pitch Green
nodes.rationale: Brand field color #071910 used as the icon background. Matches the app theme background and PWA theme_color.

nodes.label: Lime Accent
nodes.rationale: High-contrast accent #c6e86b used for the ring and crosshair. Matches the app primary/accent token so the icon is on-brand at home-screen size.

nodes.label: Rounded Square App Icon Format
nodes.rationale: 512×512 viewBox with rx=96 (~19% corner radius) follows common PWA/maskable icon geometry so the mark survives OS rounding.

nodes.label: PWA Icon Source
nodes.rationale: This SVG is the vector master for HVPS Sports installable-app icons, not an in-app illustration.

nodes.label: Sports Targeting Mark
nodes.rationale: Ring-plus-crosshair glyph: reads as a reticle, pitch marking, or plus/add affordance. Encodes sports focus (fixtures, teams, results) without lettering.
